name: Pyramid Favor Gift Box
material: Paperboard construction and printed wrap selected after size and closure review; a rigid version requires separate confirmation
structure: Small square-base pyramid carton with four sloping faces and an apex tie closure
intro: Give small event favors a pointed pyramid presentation. Start with the gift dimensions and opening method, then review the usable space beneath the sloping sides.
measure: Base width and depth, closed height, usable space at the gift height, and packed weight
checks: Check the actual gift against the sloping walls; base dimensions alone do not define usable volume.
Review apex closure, ribbon attachment and assembly with a physical prototype.
For confectionery, specify whether food is individually wrapped and confirm any direct-contact liner separately.
question: Is this the same product as the tiered pyramid catering box?
answer: No. This is a small favor-box format built around one gift or a compact assortment. The tiered catering series has graduated serving trays and a larger outer cover. Select the format by the packed contents, not just the pyramid silhouette.
distinct: Small apex-closure favor carton, not the existing multi-tier pyramid catering outer or shallow triangular portion tray.

name: Cylinder Paper Tube Gift Box
keyword: custom cylinder paper tube gift boxes
material: Paper tube body with paper-wrapped cap; wall build, liner and end construction confirmed during review
structure: Round tube body with a separate friction-fit cap
intro: Use a round paper tube for a compact cylindrical gift. Match the clear internal diameter and cap depth to the product rather than choosing by the outside size.
uses: Wrapped tea or coffee gift packs
measure: Clear internal diameter, usable body height, cap overlap, product clearance and packed weight
checks: Include the product's widest point, sleeve and protective wrap in the fit measurements.
Check cap removal and retention on an actual sample, including any pressure from the insert.
Confirm liners for aroma-sensitive or edible contents and specify a separate shipping pack where needed.
question: What measurements are needed for a tube box quotation?
answer: Send the maximum product diameter and height, packed weight and any protective wrap. State whether the cap should be flush or overlap the body. Internal usable dimensions and cap clearance must be checked on the prototype before approving artwork.
distinct: Circular tube and cap construction; no existing round tube product in the catalog.

name: Heart-Shaped Rigid Gift Box
keyword: custom heart shaped rigid gift boxes
material: Shaped rigid paperboard shell with paper wrap; liner and insert materials reviewed for the intended contents
structure: Heart-shaped rigid base and separate matching lift-off lid
intro: Create a heart-shaped presentation around a gift assortment. Plan the insert layout inside the curved outline before fixing the outside dimensions.
measure: Maximum external width and length, usable internal outline, depth, lid overlap and insert layout
checks: Map every item inside the heart outline, including the narrow point and curved lobes.
Check the lid fit and wrapping quality around the curves on a physical sample.
Review direct-food-contact liners separately; a decorative gift box is not automatically food-contact suitable.
question: Can the usable capacity be calculated from the outside width alone?
answer: No. The lobes and tapered point reduce usable space compared with a rectangular box of the same maximum width. Send an item layout or physical samples so the internal outline, insert cavities and lid clearance can be reviewed together.
distinct: Rigid curved heart shell and shaped lid, not a color variant of an existing rectangular carton.

name: Hexagonal Rigid Gift Box
material: Rigid paperboard walls with a paper wrap; board build and insert specification confirmed after review
structure: Six-sided rigid base with a separate matching lift-off lid
intro: Arrange a gift set inside a six-sided rigid box. Specify usable space across the flats and corners, then check the lid fit and insert layout.
measure: Internal distance across flats and corners, usable depth, lid depth and product layout
checks: State whether a quoted width is across flats or across opposite corners.
Check wall joints, lid alignment and insert clearance on a physical sample.
Confirm whether the pack ships assembled and allow for its carton volume in freight planning.
question: How does this differ from the existing hexagonal snack carton?
answer: This format uses a rigid base with a separate lift-off lid. The snack carton is a folding construction with different assembly and packing needs. They are not interchangeable: review the packed weight, internal layout and shipping volume for your project.
distinct: Rigid six-sided lift-off shell, distinct from the existing folding hexagonal snack carton.

name: Double-Door Drawer Advent Calendar Box
keyword: custom double door drawer advent calendar boxes
material: Paper-wrapped rigid cabinet with separate paperboard drawers; hinges, pulls and inserts reviewed as a complete assembly
structure: Two front doors opening onto a grid of individual pull-out drawers
intro: Build a countdown gift around a cabinet reveal and individual drawers. Define the contents of each compartment before deciding the cabinet size and artwork.
measure: Drawer count, internal dimensions per drawer, item weights, full cabinet dimensions and door clearance
checks: The pictured drawer layout is illustrative, not a fixed production specification; confirm the intended count and item schedule.
Check drawer extraction, stops, door movement and the loaded cabinet on a prototype.
Plan artwork approval, assembly, protective outer cartons and freight against the actual gifting date.
question: Is this a folding advent carton with perforated doors?
answer: No. This design is a rigid cabinet with two larger front doors and separate pull-out drawers. The existing folding advent carton uses a different access-panel structure. Drawer count, component dimensions and closure details are project-specific and require a sample review.
distinct: Rigid two-door drawer cabinet, not existing folding advent access-panel carton.

name: Wine Bottle Gift Box with Fitted Insert
keyword: custom wine bottle gift boxes with inserts
material: Paper-wrapped rigid outer with a fitted insert; insert material and cushioning reviewed for the bottle and delivery method
structure: Single-bottle hinged presentation box with a shaped retention insert
intro: Present a bottle in a fitted gift box rather than an empty outer shell. Size the insert around the actual bottle, including its shoulder, base and closure.
measure: Bottle height, maximum diameter, neck and shoulder profile, full weight and insert clearance
checks: Provide a dimensioned bottle drawing or sample; bottles of the same nominal volume may have different shapes.
Check bottle removal, retention and contact points with the filled bottle on a prototype.
Gift presentation does not establish courier protection; review the shipping outer and transport tests separately.
question: Can this presentation box be used alone as a shipping carton?
answer: Do not assume so. The fitted insert and gift shell must be reviewed with the filled bottle and the intended handling route. A separate protective shipping carton and suitable transit testing may be needed. No drop-protection rating is published for this design.
distinct: Bottle-specific retention insert and hinged shell rather than existing generic foldable magnetic gift box.

name: Medal & Coin Presentation Box
keyword: custom medal and coin presentation boxes
material: Paper-wrapped rigid shell with a shaped presentation insert; lining and contact materials selected for the item
structure: Compact hinged presentation case with a recessed insert and lifting notch
intro: Give a medal or commemorative coin a defined presentation position. Review the item's outline, depth and surface finish before choosing the insert and lining.
measure: Item outline, diameter or width, thickness, ribbon space, certificate size and packed weight
checks: Allow for the medal ribbon, coin capsule and any certificate rather than measuring the metal item alone.
Check the recess depth and finger access so the item can be removed without forcing it.
Review contact-material compatibility for sensitive finishes; no archival or tarnish-prevention performance is claimed.
question: Does the box include the medal, coin or certificate?
answer: No. This listing concerns the packaging design and fitted insert. Supply the item measurements or a sample and state whether a ribbon, capsule or certificate must fit. Any contents or printed certificates require separate confirmation in the quotation.
distinct: Small-item recessed presentation insert with lifting access, distinct from a generic gift shell.

name: Window-Lid Rigid Gift Box
keyword: custom window lid rigid gift boxes
material: Paper-wrapped rigid shell with a transparent lid panel; window material and attachment confirmed for the application
structure: Rigid rectangular base with a separate framed-window lift-off lid
intro: Show the gift through a framed lid window while retaining a rigid outer shape. Coordinate the visible area, insert position and artwork before sampling.
measure: Usable internal length, width and depth, window opening, border width, insert height and lid clearance
checks: Keep the main product and branding inside the visible window area at the intended viewing angle.
Review window attachment, edge finish, reflections and possible scuffing on a sample.
Confirm direct-contact liners and any environmental claims for the complete material combination separately.
question: How is this different from a folding window cake box?
answer: This design has rigid paperboard walls and a separate window lid. A folding cake carton uses a different board and assembly structure. Choose by the retail presentation, product fit and packing method; food-contact suitability must be confirmed separately if relevant.
distinct: Rigid window-lid gift shell, not existing folding cake window carton with removable base.

name: Lid-and-Base Rigid Gift Box
keyword: custom lid and base rigid gift boxes
material: Paper-wrapped rigid board; wall build, wrap and liner selected after size and finish review
structure: Two-piece rigid base and separate lift-off lid without an exposed inner neck
intro: Choose a straightforward lift-off presentation for a retail gift set. Match the lid overlap and internal depth to the product and any insert.
measure: Usable internal length, width and depth, lid overlap, insert height and packed weight
checks: Check the lid opening force and fit with the final wrap and insert, not only an unwrapped blank.
Allow clearance above the contents and below any lid lining or decoration.
Confirm assembled packing volume and the protective outer-carton arrangement before freight quotation.
question: Does this box have a hinge or magnetic flap?
answer: No. The lid is a separate component that lifts away from the base. A hinged magnetic box and a shoulder-and-neck box are different structures. State the opening style in the brief so the sample and quotation match the intended presentation.
distinct: Separate plain lift-off lid and base, no hinge or third raised neck; not existing foldable magnetic shell.

name: Shoulder-and-Neck Rigid Gift Box
keyword: custom shoulder neck rigid gift boxes
material: Three-component rigid paperboard construction with paper wraps; neck material and fit reviewed on a prototype
structure: Rigid lower base, raised inner neck and separate lid meeting at a shoulder
intro: Add a visible inner neck to a lift-off gift box for a stepped opening. Review the shoulder reveal, lid fit and usable depth as one assembly.
measure: Internal product space, neck height, shoulder reveal, lid depth, insert allowance and packed weight
checks: Specify whether the neck remains visible when closed or is concealed by the lid.
Check wrap thickness and clearance around the raised neck on the approved physical sample.
Review lift-off handling with the actual contents; the neck is not a substitute for a fitted insert or shipping protection.
question: What makes this a three-piece box rather than a standard lid-and-base box?
answer: The lower base, raised inner neck and separate lid form three structural components. The neck guides the lid and creates the shoulder detail. A standard two-piece lid-and-base box does not have this raised third component, so the dieline, fit and quotation differ.
distinct: Three-component raised-neck assembly, distinct from two-piece lift-off and existing hinged magnetic boxes.
